top-hotel-pools.title: 10 World's Most Jaw-Dropping Hotel Pools | Suites With Keith
top-hotel-pools.description: Ten hotel pools worth planning a trip around — from a cave pool on Santorini to a private island in the French Riviera, curated by travel advisor Keith Pence.
top-hotel-pools.sub: Save this guide for your next dip.

cards.name: Miramalfi
cards.desc: Carved into the cliffside, facing the Amalfi coastline.

cards.name: Le Sirenuse
cards.desc: A rooftop pool overlooking the Amalfi coastline.

cards.name: Amangiri
cards.desc: A pool built into a red rock mesa in the desert.

cards.name: Canaves Oia Suites — River Suite
cards.desc: A private cave pool running out through an arch to the caldera.

cards.name: Hotel Cap Estel
cards.desc: A pool jutting into the sea on its own private peninsula.

cards.name: Zannier Hôtels — Île de Bendor
cards.desc: A private island pool ringed by the French Riviera.

cards.name: Six Senses Ibiza
cards.desc: A cliffside infinity pool built for sunset.

cards.name: Grace Hotel Santorini
cards.desc: Cascading infinity pools suspended over the caldera.

cards.name: Mandarin Oriental, Lake Como
cards.desc: An infinity pool floating at the water's edge, framed by the Alps.

cards.name: Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc
cards.desc: The legendary Eden-Roc pool, blasted into the cliffs above the Mediterranean.

top-hotel-tennis-courts.title: The World's Most Beautiful Hotel Tennis Courts | Suites With Keith
top-hotel-tennis-courts.description: Eleven hotel tennis courts worth planning a trip around — from a cliffside court in Positano to a private island in the Maldives, curated by travel advisor Keith Pence.
top-hotel-tennis-courts.h1: The World's Most Beautiful Hotel Tennis Courts
top-hotel-tennis-courts.sub: Save this guide for your next match.

cards.name: Il San Pietro di Positano
cards.desc: A clay court blasted into the cliffside, with the Amalfi coastline as the backdrop.

cards.name: Hotel Cipriani
cards.desc: A private clay court on Giudecca Island, framed by hedges and the Venetian lagoon.

cards.name: Bürgenstock Resort
cards.desc: An alpine indoor court wrapped in timber, framed by the peaks above Lake Lucerne.

cards.name: Passalacqua
cards.desc: A single clay court perched above Lake Como, framed by cypress and the Alps.

cards.name: Cheval Blanc Randheli
cards.desc: A cerulean court cut into the jungle, ringed by palms on a private Maldivian island.

cards.name: Villa d’Este
cards.desc: Century-old courts along the water, part of one of Lake Como's grandest estates.

cards.name: Gstaad Palace
cards.desc: Chalet-side clay courts in the Alps, home to an annual stop on the pro tour.

cards.name: Splendido
cards.desc: Terraced above Portofino's harbor, with the Ligurian coastline stretching out beyond the net.

cards.name: Bawah Reserve
cards.desc: A single court cut into the rainforest, ringed by white sand and turquoise water.

cards.name: Hôtel du Cap-Eden-Roc
cards.desc: Clay courts tucked into the pines, just steps from the Mediterranean below.

cards.name: Mauna Kea Beach Hotel
cards.desc: Hawaii's original tennis park — a dozen courts set along the Kohala Coast.

top-hotel-tennis-courts.cta: That's a wrap. Save this guide, then message me — I'll plan the trip.
